title: Phenomenal Experience
text: This was a wonderful experience.  The chef was very engaged.  He called to converse with us several days prior to the event and collaborated with us on the menu.  The day of the event he welcomed us into his home treating us like old friends.  The food was fantastic, the wine and cocktails were fantastic and the atmosphere was fantastic.  I highly recommend this event and would definitely do it again.
author: Ronda_S

title: Awesome!
text: Our chef Diago was Awesome! He was extremely accommodating with the food and hostility service. He was personable for our entire couples dinner night. The food was Awesome! When our night came to an end, he went above and beyond by going down with us to assist in getting taxi service back to our hotel. That wasn't a requirement for him, but he did it from the kindness of his heart. His fiancee was a true sweetheart in assisting him! I recommend this dinner event to anyone!
author: TOSHA_J

title: The best food-experience in Barcelona
text: It was the best food we had in Barcelona! A great place to spend an amazing night with the chef Diego! Delicious dishes with a fantastic atmosphere!
author: I622YMrobertk
